subject: feat: implement the full roadmap — provider matrix, observability, governance, workflows, and scale (#19)
branch triage: retire all 8 stale local codex/* branches
decision: Delete all 8 local codex/* branches without opening PRs; GitHub main (87ff2c0, v2.4.1) already contains every salvageable change.
why: Measured each branch with two-dot diff against github/main tip rather than three-dot (which compares against the merge-base and misleadingly renders main's newer work as branch additions). Every branch is strictly behind main: codex/secrets-sync-fabric-boundary is 0 ahead/14 behind (fully merged); preserve-local-main-release-work, cd-rerun-idempotent, ci-cache-polish and final-alignment are patch-identical upstream per git cherry '-' and shipped as merged PRs #14/#11/#10; cd-publish-fix and stabilization-wip show git cherry '+' only because they were squash-merged (PRs #12 and #8) so SHAs cannot match — their content is superseded, e.g. main's tools/check_python_dist.py is 108 lines including tag validation from PR #15 versus the branch's 76, and main already completed the cmd/secretsync to cmd/secrets-sync rename that the branch would revert; go-1.26.5-runtime-fix differs from main tip in only .release-please-manifest.json and CHANGELOG.md, where main is ahead by the release-please 2.4.1 commit. Merging any branch would regress main, so no PR is warranted.

subject: branch triage re-verification: per-file supersession proof against github/main
decision: Re-verified all 8 retired branches against github/main explicitly (never --remotes or origin/*, which resolve to Gitea and can falsely report a branch as contained). Confirm the retirement of all 8, including codex/secrets-sync-stabilization-wip whose 40 branch-unique files are a deliberately superseded architecture rather than lost work.
why: Commit-count heuristics are unreliable across squash merges, so supersession was proven per file: for every file touched by each branch's unique commits, the branch blob either matches main's blob or main modified that file later. Six branches came back fully superseded (identical or main_newer for every file) and codex/secrets-sync-fabric-boundary is a strict ancestor of main. codex/secrets-sync-stabilization-wip was the one real divergence: 40 files where main is not newer, about 24 absent from main entirely. Investigated rather than assumed. Two distinct causes, both intentional. First, cmd/secretsync/, scripts/break-fork.sh, docs/ARCHITECTURE_GAP_ANALYSIS.md and several examples were deliberately deleted on main by 19730c8 'feat: retire Python bridge from secrets-sync' (2026-06-26), which predates the branch tip (2026-06-27) but is itself already merged; restoring them would revive the retired bridge. Second, the secrets-sync-operator and secrets-sync-events Helm subcharts plus api/v1alpha1 never existed on main and encode a competing CRD design: group secrets-sync.extendeddata.dev with kind SecretSync, the legacy ExtendedData-era identity. Main instead ships group secrets-sync.jbcom.dev with kind CredentialSynchronization, a flat chart with controller-deployment/rbac/serviceaccount templates, deploy/crds/secrets-sync.jbcom.dev_credentialsynchronizations.yaml, and a 470-line pkg/kubernetes/controller.go with tests, built out by PR #19 in July after the branch was abandoned. Verified main's implementation is complete and not a stub: helm lint passes, helm_chart_test.go and kubernetes_crd_test.go pass, no TODO or FIXME markers. Merging the branch would resurrect a dead CRD group and fork the operator surface, so retiring it is the correct call, not a deferral.
resolves: re-triage against github/main per corrected method
